# Security reporting

Do not disclose credentials, private source documents, or exploitable sensitive
inputs in a public issue or PR. Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting for
this repository when that option is available. Otherwise request a private contact
route from [the maintainer](https://github.com/mithudso) without publishing the
sensitive details.

Include the affected commit, a minimal redacted reproduction, expected/actual
behavior, and the relevant trust boundary. No response-time SLA or formal
supported-version policy is promised. See [the threat model](../docs/SECURITY.md)
for data handling and contributor review expectations.
